comment: The saturation, lightness and transparency inputs of every colour row do nothing with their own voltage. Fancy::modulate_color (Fancy.cpp:204-219) checks all four jacks of a row for a cable but then calls scaled_voltage(input_id_first) four times, so the hue jack's voltage is added to all four colour parts. Parameters 23 to 32 (image fitting, grayscale, the image offsets and scale, the background switch, and the four case settings) have no widget on this panel and are driven from the ON•OFF button and the two dialogs, so they get no line and no tag. Parameters 25, 26 and 27, the image X offset, Y offset and scale, are configured with an empty name (Fancy.cpp:19-21), which is why the census shows them nameless.
